declared_cases.note: Serious = at least one section carries a maximum sentence of 5+ years. 6 of 11 pending cases (CC No. 1853/1855/1856/1857/1858/1699 of 2023) each cite Prevention of Damage to Public Property Act Sec 3 (max 5 years) alongside IPC 341/427/353/506/109; these six cases share near-identical section sets and appear to stem from a single incident recorded as separate case numbers. P.R.C No. 05/2024 cites IPC 304(2) (culpable homicide not amounting to murder, max 10 years). The remaining 4 cases involve IPC 341/188/143/186/505(1)(b)/506 and a CrPC 151 matter, none exceeding a 5-year maximum. Zero convictions. Given the volume of similarly-worded PDPPA cases, this classification is flagged for reviewer double-check.
